subject: Private deployment: network boundary deep-dive — scheduling request
raw_messages:
From: Caroline Nguyen <caroline@novahealth.io>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-pm@novahealth.io; NovaHealth Security <sec-team@novahealth.io>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deploy: request for network/boundary deep-dive

Hi Jordan,

We're moving ahead with the procurement review and the Security & Infrastructure teams asked for a focused session on network boundaries and air-gapped constraints for the on-prem deployment. High level asks:
- Confirm inbound/outbound requirements for the picker + telemetry agent
- KMS/HSM connectivity and key provisioning workflow
- Requirements for an air-gapped build + allowed manual update procedure

Can Redwood run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive next week? Ideally includes someone from runtime (networking + KV cache) and a security engineer. We can share our topology ahead of time.

Thanks,
Caroline
Director of IT, NovaHealth

---
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Caroline Nguyen <caroline@novahealth.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy: request for network/boundary deep-dive

Caroline — thanks for the note and the outline. We can definitely run this session. Proposed approach:
1) 10m intro + goals
2) 25–30m architecture walk (networking, egress controls, KV/HSM paths)
3) 20m breakout Q&A (security + ops)
4) 10–15m action items and next steps (MAL, timeline, deliverables)

Who from NovaHealth would own the topology review? If you can share the diagram (or Google Drive link) ahead of time we will annotate it and bring a suggested isolation pattern.

Available slots (PT):
- Tue 18 Mar 10:00–11:15
- Tue 18 Mar 15:00–16:15
- Wed 19 Mar 09:00–10:15

If none work, we can extend to Thu/early next week. I’ll pull in Soojin (security lead) and Kim (solutions) for the deep-dive.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: caroline@novahealth.io; sec-team@novahealth.io
Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy: request for network/boundary deep-dive

Looping in a few details I'll cover in the security portion:
- Minimum outbound endpoints and domain allowlist for agent telemetry (ports + protocols)
- KMS integration modes (proxied, direct HSM, offline key import)
- Suggested attestation steps for airgap updates and signed bundles
- Evidence we usually provide for SOC-type reviews (logs, audit trails, signed manifests)

Also: can NovaHealth confirm whether the HSM will be reachable from a management plane or strictly via a one-way channel? That changes the flow I want to diagram.

-Soojin
Staff Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
From: ops-pm@novahealth.io
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai; soojin_lee@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: caroline@novahealth.io; sec-team@novahealth.io
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 08:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy: request for network/boundary deep-dive

Hi all — thanks. We prefer Tue 18 Mar 15:00–16:15 ET (that should map to Jordan's 12:00–13:15 PT slot). We'll attach a cleaned network sketch and run it through for confidentiality.

Agenda request: please allocate ~15 minutes to discuss operational runbook for emergency rollback (we need to capture who touches what during an airgap update).

I'll upload the diagram to the Drive link you proposed by 18:00 ET today.

Best,
Mark Evans
Infrastructure PM, NovaHealth

Attachment: novahealth-proposed-network-outline.png (image/png)

---
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: ops-pm@novahealth.io; caroline@novahealth.io
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 12:27:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: network boundary deep-dive — Tue 18 Mar 15:00 ET

Thanks Mark — confirmed. Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/3f8d9a2c

Pre-call deliverables from Redwood (attached):
- redwood-ops-precall-checklist.pdf (checklist of data flows + requested artifacts)
- our suggested breakout owners (networking: Marcus Lin, security: Soojin Lee, runtime: Kimberly Park)

We'll review the emergency rollback/runbook flow as requested (15m). If NovaHealth wants a short post-call artifact, we can produce an annotated diagram within 3 business days.

Meeting length: 75 minutes (15m intro/adm + 45m technical + 15m runbook/actions)

Thanks, looking forward to it.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-ops-precall-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Caroline
